solar-powered UAVs can be designed to provide continuous flight for days at low altitude, which opens up new application areas such as search and rescue or environmental monitoring.

a LALE UAV is a viable platform to provide persistent situational awareness over a large area, and that the flight endurance of a solar-powered UAV can be increased by a factor of three through careful conceptual design and by using a high-efficiency solar cell technology.
